title: Plan-Build-QA Codex Verdict
description: Schema for Codex adversarial-review output produced during /plan-build-qa Phase 3.

verdict.description: PASS = ship. NEEDS_CHANGES = Claude Opus iterates. BLOCK = stop, surface to Shane.

summary.description: One-paragraph executive summary of the review.

severity.description: S1 = must fix before merge; S2 = should fix soon; S3 = nice-to-have.

plan_acceptance_criteria_met.description: True if every acceptance criterion in PLAN.md is verifiably satisfied by the diff.

missing_tests.description: Test cases the diff should add but didn't.

evidence_artifacts.description: Absolute paths to this run's test/QA command, captured output, and exit-code artifacts.
